# BrandOS Lab™ | 品牌科学实验室™ (https://ranbrandos.com)
> Global High-Margin DTC Brand Operating System & Cognitive Brand Architecture (BrandOS™ by Ran)

## Core Positioning & Theoretical Foundations
An applied research laboratory and engineering operating system built for global DTC brands from zero to one—uniting IIBA CBAP business analysis, cognitive psychology, behavioral economics, and Rubin causal data science.

- **Founder & Principal Architect**: Ran — M.S. in Digital Marketing (North America), IIBA® CBAP Certified Business Analysis Professional, Google Data Analytics & Digital Marketing certified operator.
- **Official Website (ZH Default)**: https://ranbrandos.com/
- **Official Website (EN)**: https://ranbrandos.com/en/
- **Direct Contact**: ranzhongus@icloud.com

## BrandOS™ Six Engineering Modules (M1–M6)
- [M1 Demand Radar](https://ranbrandos.com/modules/m1-brand-foundations/) | [EN](https://ranbrandos.com/en/modules/m1-brand-foundations/): Byron Sharp CEPs + Clayton Christensen JTBD + negative-review NLP clustering to own three Tier-1 buying situations.
- [M2 Unfakeable Trust](https://ranbrandos.com/modules/m2-behavioral-science/) | [EN](https://ranbrandos.com/en/modules/m2-behavioral-science/): Michael Spence Costly Signaling + Distinctive Brand Assets (DBAs) backed by accredited testing, torture demos, and long-term warranties.
- [M3 Strategic Value Pricing](https://ranbrandos.com/modules/m3-strategic-pricing/) | [EN](https://ranbrandos.com/en/modules/m3-strategic-pricing/): Good-Better-Best three-tier pricing matrices and <=15% price-waterfall leakage audits protecting >=65% pocket gross margin.
- [M4 Algorithmic Resonance](https://ranbrandos.com/modules/m4-algorithmic-resonance/) | [EN](https://ranbrandos.com/en/modules/m4-algorithmic-resonance/): Meta DLRM Broad 1-CBO auctions, creative-as-targeting probes, and creator whitelisting cutting CPA by ~35%.
- [M5 Rapid Conversion Science](https://ranbrandos.com/modules/m5-conversion-engineering/) | [EN](https://ranbrandos.com/en/modules/m5-conversion-engineering/): MECLABS conversion heuristic, <1.0s Core Web Vitals, 100px near-CTA evidence clusters, and Schema.org AEO indexing.
- [M6 Compounding Retention](https://ranbrandos.com/modules/m6-compounding-retention/) | [EN](https://ranbrandos.com/en/modules/m6-compounding-retention/): Six adaptive lifecycle flows (50%–70% of CRM profit), BG/NBD scoring, and Rubin Holdout Geo-Lift incrementality (iROAS >= 1.20, MER 3.5–5.0).
